event.title: Ciara Mageean, European Champion Runner, Dies at 34 After Cancer Battle
event.canonical_title: Ciara Mageean, European Champion Runner, Dies at 34 After Cancer Battle
event.summary: Ciara Mageean, the Irish Olympian and European 1,500m champion, has passed away at the age of 34 after a battle with cancer. Mageean, who represented Ireland in two Olympic Games, revealed her cancer diagnosis a year prior to her death. Tributes have been paid from various figures, including President Catherine Connolly.
